rawFindings.title: Improper handling of exit code on load errors before server start
rawFindings.explanation: After a load error is detected (_start method), the code sets process.exitCode to 1 and immediately tries to exit the process with SIGINT (kill process). This is problematic because no exit code is passed to the disconnectBrowsers done callback, which causes the server to call done with code 0 (success) instead of 1 (failure). This will cause the server to exit with success even though there are load errors.
rawFindings.suggestion: Change the logic to call done with exit code 1 when load errors are present, or ensure the disconnectBrowsers function receives the appropriate failure exit code to propagate the error properly.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Run server with load errors present; server.exit code is 0 (success) instead of 1 (failure), misleading the caller that the server started successfully despite load errors.
